AI Notes.value: Independent German artist, born Munich 1964, ~60 years; among the foremost figures in contemporary art photography and sculpture, with a 30+ year career. Trained at Kunstakademie Dusseldorf (sculpture, 1989-92) and Goldsmiths London (MA, 1993-94); has taught as professor of sculpture at HFBK Hamburg since 2011. Studios in Berlin and Los Angeles (operates under Thomas Demand Studio). Represented by Matthew Marks Gallery (New York/LA), Spruth Magers (Berlin, London, LA, New York), Esther Schipper (Berlin), and Taka Ishii Gallery (Tokyo). Major solo exhibitions at MoMA New York (2005), Serpentine Gallery London (2006), Neue Nationalgalerie Berlin (2009), and ongoing international retrospectives through 2026-27. Work held in MoMA, Guggenheim, Tate, National Gallery of Canada, and many other major collections. Honorary doctorates from Royal College of Art (2012) and Accademia di Brera (2019); named Chevalier de l'ordre des Arts et des Lettres (2024).
